CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Splits the hexagons into triangles, diamonds, and trapezoids.
CONTROLS.NAME: alt_geometry

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Creates a flat plane of shapes instead of a sphere.
CONTROLS.NAME: flat_plane

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sets how much the bumps extend from the surface.
CONTROLS.NAME: size_bumps

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Number of hexagons fit onto the surface. Higher for more, smaller hexagons.
CONTROLS.NAME: num_hexes

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When on, the bumps will bounce more often, on any bass instead of the beat.
CONTROLS.NAME: bass_bump

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When DISCO is on, this sets the background flashing with hexagons as well.
CONTROLS.NAME: disco_bkg

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turns off the background coloration. Can be good when you're using media.
CONTROLS.NAME: bkg_off

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The default, rainbow color scheme gets multiplied by this color. Set it off white to limit the color palette.
CONTROLS.NAME: mult_col
